title: prisma migrate deploy
description: Deploy migrations to production using prisma migrate deploy in CI/CD pipelines.

data.text: `prisma migrate deploy` applies pending migrations to the target database without attempting to modify the schema. It is the command used in production and CI/CD pipelines.

items: Migrations are generated during development with `prisma migrate dev`
Migration files are committed to version control
In CI/CD, `prisma migrate deploy` applies all pending migrations

data.title: Deploy Migrations
data.content: Apply pending migrations to the production database.

data.text: In a CI/CD pipeline, run `prisma migrate deploy` after the database is provisioned and the `DATABASE_URL` is available. This ensures migrations are applied atomically during deployment.

data.title: Important
data.text: `prisma migrate deploy` will fail if there are pending migrations that have not been reviewed. Always generate and review migrations during development before deploying.
